# Mirabel Cotton

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is noted for her boisterous and uninhibited demeanor. She is described as being noisy, sunburned, and reckless, drawing comparisons to the behavior typical of a boy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## History

Mirabel Cotton gained a reputation for telling frightening stories to other children, scaring young [Dora](../character/dora.md) with tales about a ghost relative. Her family later provided a outlet for rebellion when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerced [Dora](../character/dora.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to fish and play with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mirabel-cotton--tommy.md)

[Tommy](../character/tommy.md) is Mirabel Cotton's brother. He and the Cotton family play and go fishing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces his sister to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).
